source: Frozen OKX crypto USDT perpetual roster plus notice-verified retired contracts, BTC/ETH/USDC excluded. Only complete hourly observations.
signal: First complete NY Monday-Sunday week. Each side first reach through NY month-end. Reclaim strictly across outer level on the inward side; next open entry must be before month expiry and before target. Later closed bars touching near edge invalidate pending entry; touch-hour high/low order is unknown. H4 and D1 closes on UTC grid.
primary_outcome: Mean independent net percentage return per filled trade, development before 2025 with exits crossing the split purged. Later segment reported for all rules.
controls: One random entry hour in same instrument/NY month/side with same percentage target distance, same stop/timeout/fees, absolute entry separation >=24h, same quartile of trailing 24h close-to-close volatility. Seeded, with replacement across pairs; no alternative is counted as unmatched.
